data.description: A gluttony fleshdreg's bite attack can wither and weaken the body of the creature it attacks. Any creature that takes damage from a gluttony fleshdreg's bite attack must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude save or become fatigued. Subsequent uses of this ability do not cause a bitten creature to become exhausted.10+CHA
